visualCharacteristics.purpose: Breadcrumb trail under the hero showing the path to the current page
notes: 56px full-width strip (19px vertical padding, content-padding gutters) directly under the hero.
Small uppercase gold labels (12px / 18px, 0.24px tracking) with 7px chevron separators (10px each side).
Current page is plain text and dimmed (#565759 on light, #d2d2d3 on dark).
On dark sections (section style 'dark') the strip is #1d1f22 and the chevrons are white at 25% opacity.

contentPattern.structure: one row, one cell holding an unordered list; each <li> holds a link except the last, which is plain text for the current page

sectionMetadata: style: dark (optional, white-text strip on dark background)

usage.description: Breadcrumb trail placed in its own section right under the page hero.

reuseGuidance: Put the block alone in its own section directly under the hero; the block removes the section's global padding so the strip is 56px high. Add section style 'dark' when the page band is dark.
